lessons:
Sing anything to God|The Psalms hold not only praise but lament, fear, and anger. Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your heart before him. (Ps 62:8)
Where the songs were born|These songs were born in wildernesses, caves, and ruined cities. The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves those whose spirit is crushed. (Ps 34:18)
The Word in your heart through song|The Psalms are both Scripture to read and prayers to sing. Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, and with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs praise God with thankful hearts. (Col 3:16)
gospelBridge: On the cross, Jesus cried out in the words of a psalm: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? (Ps 22:1, Matt 27:46). After he rose, he said that everything written about him in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms must be fulfilled. (Luke 24:44)
invite:
If the story of God you met on this road has stayed with you, come and meet Jesus, who stands at the center of that story. Walk 'The Footsteps of Jesus' from the beginning, and visit a church near you. We pray that in worship and in the Word you will meet God, be adopted as his child, and know the blessing of calling God 'Father.' (Rom 8:15)
He is still standing at the door, waiting for you. (Rev 3:20)
seekerHead: For those who do not yet know him
